risk_note: B2-02zg (admin audit, RV2; BR-ID-33; takes over B2-02ze). Free text written into audit_logs (operator notes, reject / close reasons, system audit detail) is normalised (NFKC, Unicode dashes / white space) and masked before it is stored: mobile numbers 3+4, identity numbers first 1 + last 1 (18 digits incl. X, 15), cards last 4, other runs of >= 11 digits last 4; any run of non-white-space characters that holds an '@' is replaced whole by '***' with no domain shown (owner 2026-11-27 '验证甲，邮箱乙', orchestrator D10-3479 / D10-3495; planning 08 BR-ID-33 at SPEC_REF b3b8ff548af9). Structured fields and the payout-account display are unchanged. Only apps/api/src/modules/admin/infra/audit-redaction.ts and its unit tests change; rule tests under test/spec/admin/audit-free-text-pii/**.

reviews.note: Codex money review via tools/agent/codex-run.sh (implementation by Opus, approvals 27). Under B2-02zg: r1 fail 3 S1, r2 fail 2 S1, r3 fail S0+S1 (regular 3/3); r4 fail 2 S0 (approvals 230, D10-3382); owner chose whole-local-part masking (D10-3427 ④, approvals 233): r5 fail S0+S1+S2; owner changed the rule to masking the whole '@' run without domain ('验证甲，邮箱乙', D10-3479, approvals 235): r6 (incremental) pass, 2 S2 (U+0085 not treated as white space: over-masks; a constructed 19-digit card whose 18-digit prefix passes the identity check digit, unreachable). B2-02ze history (r1-r5) is in its own evidence notes.

spec_test_review.note: Rule tests by an independent Claude (ledger tester claude-independent). r1 (codex, full) fail 4 S1 -> write-test 2; r2 (codex) fail 1 S1 -> write-test 3 (regular rounds used); after the owner's rule changes: write-test 4 (approvals 233) -> r3 (claude-independent, incremental) fail 1 S1 + 1 S2, sample gaps (dash left of '@', mobile local part, unrecognised domain glued to punctuation) moved to the implementation's must-satisfy unit tests by orchestrator ruling D10-3444; write-test 5 (approvals 235) -> r4 (claude-independent, incremental) fail 1 S1 + 1 S2, sample gaps (dash / minus left of '@', tab as a boundary) moved to implementation must-satisfy items by D10-3495; both registered as FU-B2-02ZG-SPEC-HYPHEN-LOCAL (test-change after landing). Money review r6 confirmed those implementation unit tests.
